cards.back: Double makes a number twice as big. Half splits a number into 2 equal parts. They are opposites.
cards.say: Double and half. Double makes a number twice as big. Half splits a number into two equal parts. They are opposites.

cards.say: Check: half of fourteen is seven. How can you check with a double? Double seven is fourteen. Doubling checks halving.
